name: UCM: Ultimate Combat Mission
summary: You are a warmonger and plan to escape from this maximum security prison that orbits the earth with your fellow inmate Mandroid (played by a second player at the same time). Because Earth's prisons are full, space stations have been built to house criminals like you. You've managed to arm yourself with a weapon (Mandroid, a laser) and try to get past waves of guards coming at you by dodging or shooting them. When you reach the end of the prison, a space shuttle awaits you to take you to freedom. UCM: Ultimate Combat Mission is a run 'n gun game that gives you a high angle view of your player from a third-person perspective. They move vertically up while the screen scrolls.
